name: Salesforce
one_liner: Enterprise customer relationship management and cloud sales operations platform.
access_details: Free Developer Edition accounts provide full API access; production requires paid licenses.
main_blocker: OAuth Connected App permissions and complex permission-set scopes.

name: HubSpot
one_liner: Inbound marketing, CRM, sales pipeline, and customer service platform.
access_details: Free developer test accounts or free CRM tier allow generating Private App tokens in minutes.
main_blocker: None (instant private app tokens for single-tenant; standard OAuth for multi-tenant).

name: Pipedrive
one_liner: Sales pipeline management and deal tracking CRM for revenue teams.
access_details: 14-day free trial or free developer sandbox with instant API token generation.
main_blocker: None (personal API token available in user settings immediately).

name: Attio
one_liner: Modern AI-native and customizable relationship management platform.
access_details: Free tier available; API keys can be minted directly in workspace settings.
main_blocker: None (clean modern REST v2 API with granular read/write scopes).

name: Twenty
one_liner: Open-source extensible CRM designed as a modern alternative to Salesforce.
access_details: Completely free open-source (self-hosted) or free tier cloud hosting.
main_blocker: None (open developer environment with OpenAPI schema & GraphQL playground).

name: Podio
one_liner: Citrix-owned modular workspace and custom CRM application platform.
access_details: Free plan (up to 5 users) allows creating API keys in account settings.
main_blocker: Legacy rate-limiting architecture and older XML/JSON schema inconsistencies.

name: Zoho CRM
one_liner: Multi-channel sales and customer lifecycle CRM with extensive developer tools.
access_details: Free edition (up to 3 users) and free Developer Console access for client creation.
main_blocker: Multi-region domain routing (.com, .eu, .in, .com.au) and refresh token mechanics.

name: Close
one_liner: Inside sales CRM featuring native multi-channel calling, SMS, and email sequences.
access_details: 14-day free trial with immediate API key generation; paid plans required post-trial.
main_blocker: Paid plan required after trial ($49+/user/mo) for continued execution.

name: Copper
one_liner: Google Workspace-integrated CRM recommended for Gmail and Google Calendar users.
access_details: 14-day free trial; requires Google Workspace account to generate API tokens.
main_blocker: Custom header requirement (`X-PW-AccessToken`, `X-PW-UserEmail`) and Google dependency.

name: DealCloud
one_liner: Institutional deal management and capital markets CRM by Intapp.
access_details: Enterprise contract required; API credentials provisioned strictly by tenant admins and Intapp support.
main_blocker: No public developer sandbox; enterprise customer agreement mandatory.

name: Zendesk
one_liner: Omnichannel customer support ticketing, knowledge base, and live agent platform.
access_details: 14-day free trial or free sponsored Developer account for app developers.
main_blocker: Subdomain URL routing (`{subdomain}.zendesk.com`) and rate limits.

name: Intercom
one_liner: AI customer service platform featuring conversational support, bots, and ticketing.
access_details: Free Developer Workspace can be created instantly in Intercom Developer Hub.
main_blocker: Intercom app review required for public marketplace distribution.

name: Freshdesk
one_liner: Cloud customer support software with ticketing, automation, and team collaboration.
access_details: Free plan (up to 10 agents) with instant personal API key from profile settings.
main_blocker: Domain-specific endpoint routing (`yourdomain.freshdesk.com`).

name: Front
one_liner: Customer operations platform combining shared inboxes with automated workflows.
access_details: 7-day free trial or free developer sandbox upon registration.
main_blocker: Paid plan required after trial ($19+/seat/mo).

name: Pylon
one_liner: Modern B2B support platform managing customer communication across Slack, Teams, and email.
access_details: Credentials generated in Settings > API Keys; requires active Pylon organization plan.
main_blocker: Requires existing paid customer account or sales-assisted onboarding trial.

name: LiveAgent
one_liner: Help desk and real-time live chat software with multi-channel ticketing.
access_details: 14-day free trial or free tier; API keys generated under Configuration > System > API.
main_blocker: None (Swagger/OpenAPI v3 spec available for direct tool generation).

name: Plain
one_liner: Modern customer support platform built specifically for B2B engineering teams.
access_details: Free tier available (up to 100 threads/month); instant API key creation in Settings.
main_blocker: None (developer-first GraphQL API with fine-grained permissions).

name: Help Scout
one_liner: Customer communication platform providing shared inboxes and self-service docs.
access_details: 15-day free trial; OAuth app credentials created in Profile > My Apps.
main_blocker: OAuth token expiration (short-lived tokens require automatic refresh cycles).

name: Gorgias
one_liner: Ecommerce helpdesk built specifically for Shopify, BigCommerce, and Magento stores.
access_details: 7-day free trial; API key generated immediately under Settings > REST API.
main_blocker: Requires connecting a mock/live ecommerce store to exercise order-action endpoints.

name: Gladly
one_liner: Customer service platform centered on lifelong customer conversation threads.
access_details: No self-serve developer tier; credentials provisioned by tenant administrators on enterprise contracts.
main_blocker: Enterprise contract required; closed developer ecosystem with no public sandbox.

name: Slack
one_liner: Enterprise team messaging, channels, workflow automations, and collaboration hub.
auth_methods: OAuth2 (Bot/User Scopes); Bot User OAuth Token (`xoxb-`)
access_details: Free Slack workspace creation allows creating Slack Apps and generating bot tokens in seconds.
main_blocker: Granular scope configuration and workspace admin permission in enterprise tenants.

name: Twilio
one_liner: Programmable cloud communications API for SMS, voice calls, WhatsApp, and video.
auth_methods: Account SID + Auth Token (Basic Auth); API Key + Secret
access_details: Self-serve free trial account with complimentary test balance and sandbox numbers.
main_blocker: Carrier regulatory verification (A2P 10DLC registration in US for SMS outbound).

name: Zoho Cliq
one_liner: Team communication, channels, and workplace chat tool by Zoho.
access_details: Free plan (up to 100 users) provides immediate developer bot creation.
main_blocker: Zoho multi-DC authentication redirection (.com, .eu, etc.).

name: Lark (Larksuite)
one_liner: Enterprise collaboration suite integrating chat, calendar, docs, and video (ByteDance).
auth_methods: OAuth2 (App Access Token / Tenant Access Token)
access_details: Free developer console access; app ID and App Secret created self-serve.
main_blocker: Multi-tier token exchange protocol (internal app vs custom app credentials).

name: Pumble
one_liner: Team messaging and collaboration application designed as an affordable Slack alternative.
access_details: Free plan allows generating bot tokens and webhook URLs in workspace administration.
main_blocker: Narrow public API surface compared to Slack; primarily focused on messages and webhooks.

name: Discord
one_liner: Voice, video, and text communication platform for communities and gaming groups.
access_details: Free developer portal allows instant bot application creation and token copying.
main_blocker: Privileged Gateway Intents (Message Content Intent) required for message listening.

name: Telegram
one_liner: Cloud-based mobile and desktop messaging app with extensive bot automation ecosystem.
access_details: Completely free self-serve bot creation via @BotFather in less than 30 seconds.
main_blocker: None (fastest bot provisioning in modern SaaS).

name: WhatsApp Business
one_liner: Enterprise customer messaging on WhatsApp via Meta Cloud API.
access_details: Free Cloud API sandbox with test phone numbers via Meta for Developers portal.
main_blocker: Meta Business verification required for production phone numbers; pre-approved message templates.

name: Aircall
one_liner: Cloud business phone and call center platform integrated with CRMs and helpdesks.
auth_methods: API ID + API Token (Basic Auth); OAuth2
access_details: 7-day free trial or free developer sandbox upon registration.
main_blocker: Live outbound calling testing requires VoIP carrier provisioning.

name: Vonage
one_liner: Communications platform APIs for SMS, voice, video, verification, and WhatsApp.
auth_methods: API Key + Secret (Basic Auth); JWT (Private Key)
access_details: Free developer account with initial €2 test credits and sandbox environment.
main_blocker: Carrier registration fees and compliance for production SMS sender IDs.

name: Google Ads
one_liner: Online advertising platform for Google Search, YouTube, and Display Network.
access_details: Test accounts can be created self-serve; production Developer Token requires formal Google review.
main_blocker: Mandatory Developer Token application, Google compliance review, and strict API access tiers.

name: Meta Ads
one_liner: Marketing API for programmatic advertising on Facebook and Instagram.
access_details: Development mode is self-serve; Standard/Advanced access requires Meta App Review & Business Verification.
main_blocker: App Review and Business Verification required to access live non-developer ad accounts.

name: LinkedIn Ads
one_liner: B2B advertising platform for sponsored content, message ads, and lead generation.
access_details: Requires application approval into the LinkedIn Marketing Developer Program.
main_blocker: Partner approval gate; applications are frequently scrutinized or rejected for early-stage tools.

name: GoHighLevel
one_liner: All-in-one marketing, CRM, appointment booking, and funnel platform for agencies.
access_details: 14-day trial or paid agency plan ($97+/mo) required; Developer Marketplace allows OAuth app creation.
main_blocker: Requires paid agency account to create and bind OAuth marketplace apps.

name: Mailchimp
one_liner: Email marketing, audience management, and automated campaign platform (Intuit).
access_details: Free plan (up to 500 contacts) allows generating API keys immediately in account settings.
main_blocker: Must parse datacenter prefix (`us1`, `us20`) from API key to construct target URL.

name: Klaviyo
one_liner: Data and marketing automation platform for ecommerce SMS and email campaigns.
access_details: Free account (up to 250 contacts) with instant private API key generation.
main_blocker: Mandatory `revision` header (`revision: 2024-07-15`) required on modern JSON:API endpoints.

name: systeme.io
one_liner: All-in-one funnel builder, email marketing, and online course platform.
access_details: Free plan (up to 2,000 contacts) includes API key generation in Settings > Public API keys.
main_blocker: None (clean, straightforward REST API key auth).

name: Pinterest
one_liner: Visual discovery engine for saving ideas, pins, boards, and ecommerce catalog ads.
access_details: Trial access in developer portal allows instant API tokens for up to 5 sandbox accounts.
main_blocker: Moving from Trial Access to Standard Access requires app review approval.

name: Threads (Meta)
one_liner: Text-based social platform by Instagram/Meta for public conversations.
access_details: Self-serve setup in Meta Developer portal; test users can publish immediately.
main_blocker: Publishing to production non-tester accounts requires Meta App Review.

name: SendGrid
one_liner: Cloud transactional and marketing email delivery infrastructure (Twilio).
access_details: Free tier (100 emails/day forever) with instant API key creation in Settings.
main_blocker: Domain sender identity verification (SPF/DKIM) needed to prevent spam filtering.

name: Shopify
one_liner: Global multi-channel commerce platform for online stores and retail point-of-sale.
access_details: Free Shopify Partner account allows creating unlimited free development stores with full API access.
main_blocker: Protected Customer Data approval required for public app store apps (bypassed in Custom Apps).

name: WooCommerce
one_liner: Open-source customizable ecommerce platform built on WordPress.
auth_methods: Consumer Key + Secret (Basic Auth over HTTPS); OAuth1.0a
primary_auth: Consumer Key + Secret (Basic Auth over HTTPS)
access_details: 100% free open-source software; keys generated in WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API.
main_blocker: Requires a live or local WordPress environment running WooCommerce.

name: BigCommerce
one_liner: Open SaaS ecommerce platform with headless architecture for high-volume merchants.
access_details: 15-day free trial or free developer sandbox store in Developer Portal.
main_blocker: Store hash requirement in API request path (`/stores/{store_hash}/v3/`).

name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
one_liner: Enterprise B2C and B2B commerce platform for high-scale global brands.
access_details: Enterprise contract required; developer sandbox access requires Salesforce Account Manager client.
main_blocker: No self-serve developer sandbox for non-customers/non-partners; closed enterprise gate.

name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
one_liner: Enterprise ecommerce platform available as open source or Adobe Commerce cloud.
access_details: Free open-source edition (Magento Open Source) can be self-hosted; Integration token generated in Admin.
main_blocker: Self-hosting complexity for Open Source; cloud edition requires Adobe enterprise license.

name: Squarespace
one_liner: Website builder and ecommerce platform for creative businesses and merchants.
access_details: 14-day website trial allows testing; API key generation requires Commerce Basic or Advanced paid plan.
main_blocker: Commerce APIs are paywalled behind Commerce Basic/Advanced tiers ($27+/mo).

name: Ecwid
one_liner: Embeddable ecommerce widget and shopping cart by Lightspeed.
access_details: Free registered developer account allows creating apps and generating test tokens.
main_blocker: Free store tier limits API calls; developer account required for full test store.

name: Gumroad
one_liner: E-commerce platform for digital creators, courses, books, and software licenses.
access_details: Free creator account creation; instant Personal Access Token generation in Settings > Advanced.
main_blocker: None (straightforward REST endpoints for sales, products, and subscribers).

name: Amazon Selling Partner
one_liner: REST API suite for Amazon sellers and vendors to manage orders, inventory, and listings.
access_details: Requires Professional Selling account ($39.99/mo), Developer Profile registration, and strict security review.
main_blocker: Data Protection Policy questionnaire, AWS IAM SigV4 signing complexity, and developer profile vetting.

name: fanbasis
one_liner: Creator monetization platform offering personalized fan video shoutouts and experiences.
access_details: No public developer portal or documentation; internal web endpoints only.
main_blocker: No documented public API; would require reverse engineering or corporate partnership.

name: DataForSEO
one_liner: Raw SEO, SERP, backlink, and digital marketing data APIs for software developers.
access_details: Free registration with $1 test credit for sandbox and live API calls.
main_blocker: Pure pay-as-you-go credit exhaustion after initial $1 bonus.

name: SE Ranking
one_liner: SEO suite for keyword tracking, backlink analysis, competitor research, and audits.
access_details: Standard 14-day free trial does not include API; API requires paid Pro or Business subscription.
main_blocker: API access is gated behind higher-tier paid subscriptions ($100+/mo).

name: Ahrefs
one_liner: Leading SEO backlink index, search traffic intelligence, and keyword database.
access_details: Enterprise subscription required; API calls consume metered API units with expensive minimum commitments.
main_blocker: High commercial barrier; API v3 requires Enterprise plan and unit purchasing.

name: MrScraper
one_liner: Visual web scraper and automated data extraction platform with scheduled scraping.
access_details: Free plan includes 30 scrapes/month; instant API key generation in dashboard.
main_blocker: Low monthly scrape limits on free tier.

name: Apify
one_liner: Cloud platform for web scraping, data extraction, and serverless web crawling Actors.
access_details: Free tier with recurring $5 monthly platform credits; instant personal API token.
main_blocker: None (premier agent scraping ecosystem with turnkey Actor execution).

name: Firecrawl
one_liner: API service that turns websites into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured JSON.
access_details: Free tier with 500 scrape credits; instant API key generation.
main_blocker: None (built natively for LLMs and agent toolkits).

name: Bright Data
one_liner: Enterprise proxy network, web unlocker, and pre-built dataset scraping platform.
access_details: Self-serve trial with initial credits; pay-as-you-go billing available.
main_blocker: KYC identity verification required before unlocking residential proxies.

name: Sherlock
one_liner: Open-source OSINT Python tool hunting usernames across 400+ social networks.
access_details: 100% free open-source software on GitHub; run via python or docker locally.
main_blocker: No hosted cloud REST API; requires running as a local CLI wrapper or microservice.

name: Waterfall.io
one_liner: B2B contact enrichment and company intelligence waterfall aggregation platform.
access_details: Private access; requires sales request or customer onboarding to obtain API credentials.
main_blocker: Sales onboarding gate; no instant self-serve developer portal.

name: Clay
one_liner: AI-powered prospecting, company intelligence, and automated outbound data platform.
access_details: 14-day trial with 100 free credits; paid plans from $149/mo for production enrichment.
main_blocker: Primary power is in-app table UI; API exposes webhooks and table row ingestion.

name: GitHub
one_liner: World-leading cloud code repository, pull request collaboration, and CI/CD platform.
auth_methods: Personal Access Token (fine-grained); OAuth2; GitHub App
access_details: Completely free self-serve account; PATs created in seconds under Developer Settings.
main_blocker: Selecting fine-grained token repository scopes.

name: Vercel
one_liner: Frontend cloud platform for developing, previewing, and shipping web applications.
access_details: Free Hobby tier with instant token creation in Account Settings > Tokens.
main_blocker: Team ID query parameter required when querying team-scoped resources.

name: Netlify
one_liner: Cloud platform for building, deploying, and scaling modern web apps and serverless sites.
access_details: Free Starter tier allows generating personal access tokens in user settings.
main_blocker: None (complete OpenAPI spec available).

name: Cloudflare
one_liner: Global edge network offering DNS, DDoS mitigation, CDN, and Workers serverless compute.
access_details: Free plan covers DNS, CDN, and Workers (100k requests/day); API tokens minted instantly.
main_blocker: Configuring zone vs account level permissions for specific token templates.

name: Supabase
one_liner: Open-source Firebase alternative providing Postgres, Auth, Realtime, Storage, and Edge Functions.
auth_methods: API Key (`anon` / `service_role` Bearer); Personal Access Token (Management API)
access_details: Free tier (2 free projects); API keys displayed in Project Settings > API immediately.
main_blocker: Distinguishing data-plane keys (PostgREST) from platform Management API tokens.

name: Neo4j
one_liner: Native graph database platform for modeling complex networks and knowledge graphs.
auth_methods: Basic Auth (username:password); Bearer Token (Aura API Key)
access_details: Free AuraDB cloud instance; credentials downloaded during database provisioning.
main_blocker: Primary data manipulation is Cypher query language over Bolt, not pure REST.

name: Snowflake
one_liner: Cloud data warehouse and analytics data cloud platform.
access_details: 30-day free trial with $400 credits; SQL REST API v2 accessible with generated keypair.
main_blocker: RSA Key-pair generation and JWT header assembly for SQL REST API.

name: MongoDB Atlas
one_liner: Fully managed multi-cloud document database service.
auth_methods: Digest Auth (Public/Private Key); Bearer Token; Atlas Data API Key
access_details: Free M0 Sandbox cluster; programmatic API keys created under Access Management.
main_blocker: Requires IP Access List entry or allowing `0.0.0.0/0`; HTTP Digest auth for admin endpoints.

name: Datadog
one_liner: Observability, monitoring, and security service for cloud-scale applications.
auth_methods: Dual Key: API Key (`DD-API-KEY`) + Application Key (`DD-APPLICATION-KEY`)
access_details: 14-day free trial; keys generated under Organization Settings > API Keys and Application Keys.
main_blocker: Must send both `DD-API-KEY` and `DD-APPLICATION-KEY` headers for write actions.

name: Sentry
one_liner: Application performance monitoring and error tracking platform for software teams.
access_details: Free Developer tier with 5k errors/month; tokens minted in User Settings > API > Auth Tokens.
main_blocker: Organization slug and project slug parameterization across endpoint URLs.

name: Notion
one_liner: Connected workspace for notes, wiki documents, and project databases.
access_details: Free workspace; create Internal Integration at notion.so/my-integrations instantly.
main_blocker: User must explicitly click 'Connect to' on specific pages/databases to grant bot access.

name: Airtable
one_liner: Low-code platform for creating relational databases and custom workflow applications.
access_details: Free tier available; create Personal Access Token at airtable.com/create/tokens.
main_blocker: Tokens require explicit scope and base permission assignment during creation.

name: Linear
one_liner: Streamlined issue tracking and sprint planning tool for high-performance software teams.
access_details: Free tier (up to 250 active issues); generate API key in Settings > Account > API.
main_blocker: Strictly GraphQL API requires structured query assembly instead of simple REST GET/POST.

name: Jira
one_liner: Agile project and issue tracking tool for enterprise software development teams (Atlassian).
access_details: Free plan (up to 10 users); generate API token at id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens.
main_blocker: Resolving Atlassian `cloudId` when using 3-legged OAuth (bypassed with Basic API token).

name: Asana
one_liner: Work management and collaboration platform for cross-functional project execution.
access_details: Free Personal tier (up to 10 teammates); PAT created in Developer App Console.
main_blocker: Handling Asana workspace GID and project GID parameters.

name: Monday.com
one_liner: Work operating system with customizable visual boards for projects, CRM, and dev sprints.
access_details: Free tier (up to 2 seats) or 14-day Pro trial; API token generated under Avatar > Developers.
main_blocker: GraphQL v2 mutation syntax and JSON column values encoding.

name: ClickUp
one_liner: All-in-one productivity platform replacing tasks, docs, goals, and chat.
access_details: Free Forever plan; personal API key generated under User Settings > Apps.
main_blocker: Deep hierarchy path traversal (`team_id` -> `space_id` -> `folder_id` -> `list_id` -> `task_id`).

name: Coda
one_liner: All-in-one interactive collaborative doc platform blending text, spreadsheets, and apps.
access_details: Free tier available; create API token at coda.io/account under API settings.
main_blocker: None (clean modern REST v1 API).

name: Smartsheet
one_liner: Enterprise spreadsheet-like work management platform for business operations.
access_details: 30-day free trial; generate token under Account > Personal Settings > API Access.
main_blocker: Requires paid plan ($9+/user/mo) after 30-day trial expires.

name: Harvest
one_liner: Time tracking, project budgeting, and client invoicing software for professional services.
access_details: Free plan (1 seat, 2 projects) or 30-day trial; create Personal Access Token at id.getharvest.com/developers.
main_blocker: Mandatory dual header: requires both `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and `Harvest-Account-Id: <id>`.

name: Stripe
one_liner: Global financial infrastructure platform for internet payments, billing, and payouts.
auth_methods: Secret API Key (Bearer `sk_test_` / `sk_live_`); Restricted Key; OAuth (Connect)
access_details: Completely free test mode; instant sandbox API keys without bank account verification.
main_blocker: None (gold standard developer experience and API design).

name: Plaid
one_liner: Financial data network connecting consumer bank accounts to fintech applications.
access_details: Free Sandbox environment with test credentials available immediately upon signup.
main_blocker: Production banking data requires compliance questionnaire and production key approval.

name: Binance
one_liner: Global cryptocurrency exchange platform for spot, futures, and algorithmic trading.
auth_methods: API Key + Secret (HMAC-SHA256 / Ed25519 signature in headers)
access_details: Free Spot Testnet allows instant API key generation; live trading requires identity KYC.
main_blocker: Cryptographic timestamping and HMAC-SHA256 signature generation on private endpoints.

name: Paygent Connect
one_liner: Merchant payment gateway integration platform (NMI / Japanese market payment gateway).
auth_methods: Security Key / Merchant Private Key; Basic Auth
access_details: Requires formal merchant processing agreement, business underwriting, and merchant account setup.
main_blocker: Strict merchant underwriting contract required; no public self-serve developer sandbox.

name: iPayX
one_liner: Enterprise and municipal utility bill payment processing and payment gateway.
auth_methods: API Token; Basic Auth / Mutual TLS
access_details: No public self-serve portal; access is strictly gated behind enterprise utility contracts.
main_blocker: Closed legacy utility processing platform with no public developer signup or documentation.

name: QuickBooks
one_liner: Accounting and financial management software for small businesses (Intuit).
access_details: Free Intuit Developer account provides instant sandbox company and OAuth app keys.
main_blocker: Production credentials require annual security assessment and app compliance review.

name: Xero
one_liner: Cloud accounting software for small businesses, accountants, and bookkeepers.
auth_methods: OAuth 2.0 (PKCE / Client Credentials for Custom Connections)
access_details: 30-day free trial and free Xero Developer account with Demo Company access.
main_blocker: Must resolve tenant ID from `/connections` endpoint and pass `xero-tenant-id` header in requests.

name: Brex
one_liner: Corporate cards, spend management, business banking, and travel booking for startups.
access_details: Tokens generated in Settings > Developer for verified Brex corporate account holders.
main_blocker: Requires an active, verified US corporate entity and funded Brex account.

name: Ramp
one_liner: Corporate card and financial operations platform offering automated expense control and bill pay.
access_details: API keys generated in Ramp Dashboard > Settings > Developer for approved business accounts.
main_blocker: Requires approved business entity on Ramp to generate API tokens.

name: PitchBook
one_liner: Comprehensive data and research platform covering venture capital, private equity, and M&A.
access_details: Strictly enterprise contract ($25k-$50k+/year); credentials provisioned directly by PitchBook representative.
main_blocker: Heavy enterprise paywall and sales gate; absolutely no public developer sandbox.

name: NotebookLM
one_liner: AI-powered personalized research assistant that grounds summaries on user-provided sources.
auth_methods: Google Cloud OAuth2 / Service Account (Vertex AI)
access_details: Consumer app has no standalone public API; enterprise programmatic capabilities are accessed via Google Cloud Vertex AI Search & Conversation API.
main_blocker: No standalone public NotebookLM endpoint; developers must integrate Google Cloud Vertex AI Search / Grounding API or use community browser automation.

name: Otter AI
one_liner: AI meeting assistant providing automated real-time transcription, summaries, and action items.
auth_methods: Enterprise Token / OAuth2; MCP Client Config
access_details: Official Otter MCP server and API endpoints are restricted to Otter Enterprise account tiers with admin approval.
main_blocker: Official MCP server is paywalled behind Otter Enterprise subscription plans.

name: Fathom
one_liner: AI meeting recorder that records, transcribes, and summarizes Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams calls.
access_details: API keys generated in Fathom dashboard under Settings > API; requires Fathom Team Edition ($19+/mo).
main_blocker: API access is gated to paid Team Edition accounts; free tier cannot generate keys.

name: Consensus
one_liner: AI-powered academic search engine extracting scientific consensus and paper findings.
auth_methods: API Key (Bearer Token) / Commercial Partner Token
access_details: Commercial API access requires partnership agreement or direct sales inquiry (OAuth requested by community).
main_blocker: Public self-serve developer tier not yet open; OAuth2 is requested by users but currently partner inquiry only.

name: Reducto
one_liner: High-accuracy AI document ingestion and visual parser converting complex PDFs into structured data.
access_details: Free developer tier with $10 free parsing credits upon registration; instant API key.
main_blocker: None (first-class developer onboarding and clean REST endpoints).

name: Devin
one_liner: Autonomous AI software engineering agent developed by Cognition.
auth_methods: Personal Access Token / API Key (`Bearer cogn_...`); MCP Server Protocol
access_details: Requires active paid Devin subscription ($500/mo); API keys generated in Settings > Integrations.
main_blocker: High subscription barrier ($500/month) required to obtain API key and run Devin MCP sessions.

name: higgsfield
one_liner: Generative video and multimodal video creation platform for mobile video creators.
auth_methods: CLI Token / Session Auth / API Token
access_details: Free account registration allows downloading CLI and running initial model generations with free credits.
main_blocker: Heavy GPU inference credit consumption for video models.

name: Mermaid CLI
one_liner: Command-line interface to compile Mermaid text diagram definitions into SVG, PNG, and PDF files.
access_details: 100% free open-source npm package (`@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli`); zero credentials needed.
main_blocker: Requires headless Chromium/Puppeteer environment in container runtime.

name: YouTube Transcript
one_liner: API service for extracting timed captions, subtitles, and video transcripts from YouTube videos.
auth_methods: API Key (Bearer / Header `X-API-Key`); None (if using open-source Python library)
access_details: Free tier available via RapidAPI or transcriptapi.com (50-100 free requests/month).
main_blocker: YouTube IP-blocking and rate limiting on unofficial scrapers; resolved by hosted proxy API.

name: Grain
one_liner: AI meeting intelligence software that records sales calls, summarizes notes, and automates CRM logging.
access_details: API access requires a paid Business or Enterprise workspace plan ($15+/seat/month).
main_blocker: API generation is restricted to paid Business/Enterprise tier workspaces.
